hero.title: Axopar 22 Spyder
hero.heading: Axopar 22 Spyder – The Finest 22-Foot Open Day Boat
hero.intro:
Axopar has always been known for creating exciting and innovative boats with great handling and performance, combined with solid, competitive pricing for customers.
We have expanded our fleet of premium boats to the competitive 22-footer market with a product that, together with fantastic value for money, will represent all the key unique features and functionalities that define a true Axopar.

sections.title: The best 22 footer on the market
sections.intro: The unique and eye-grabbing Axopar 22 not only has the looks, but is a true performer offering one of the best driving experiences ever; unparalleled stability, agility, and handling, combined with class-best seaworthiness. Built to match your needs. For the best experience on the water!

sections.title: Easy to handle
sections.intro: With the same Axopar-DNA as its bigger siblings, the 22 Spyder offers responsive handling and a safe, confident demeanor that lets you relax and focus on having a good time out on the water. The twin-step, low center-of-gravity hull with a deep-vee configuration ensures good directional stability and fantastic grip during cornering.

sections.title: Clean Helm Area
sections.intro: The uncluttered and intuitive helm area is developed so that you will have full control over the boat and its functions in all situations.

sections.title: Welcome to the Hull of Fame
sections.intro:
Every Axopar begins where the boating experience truly begins: below the waterline. Many boaters have learned to accept certain compromises as normal. Our hull-first approach gets the fundamentals right from the start. Since the first Axopar 28 was launched in 2014, this philosophy has shaped our multi-award-winning range, helped create the adventure boating category, and contributed to more than 7,600 Axopar boats being sold worldwide.

Discover the Hull of Fame and the engineering behind the distinctive Axopar driving experience.

items.name: Mediterrana upgrade
items.title: Mediterrana upgrade
items.text: The Mediterrana Edition adds premium upholstery and sunbed cushions to transform the Axopar 22 Spyder into a chic, Mediterranean-inspired day cruiser, with optional soft deck flooring for added style and comfort.

items.name: Optional Toilet
items.title: Optional toilet
items.text: Choose an optional toilet for your Axopar 22 Spyder: Electric fresh water flush with 25 L tank or Manual sea water flush with 25 L tank.

items.name: Optional deck shower
items.title: Optional deck shower
items.text: The optional aft deck shower is designed for rinsing off after swimming or water sports, adding convenience and comfort for day boating where quick freshwater access enhances the overall experience.

items.name: Premium Navigation & Tech Options
items.title: Premium Navigation & Tech Options
items.text: Big‑boat tech in a 22‑footer—Axopar 22 blends large helm displays, full engine integration, and premium audio/lighting.

items.name: Splash Proof USB Outlet in the Console
items.title: Splash Proof USB Outlet in the Console
items.text: Never miss the chance to capture and share every moment, by keeping the juice in your handheld devices topped up. The splash-proof USB outlet is IPX6 classified and can charge two devices at the same time, with 2.1 A per outlet.

items.name: Storage Possibilities
items.title: Storage Possibilities
items.text: Bringing along water toys, camping gear, or some other adventure equipment? You can conveniently store it all away in one of the many storage spaces located across the boat.

items.name: Storage Pocket for Center Console Wall
items.title: Storage Pocket for Center Console Wall
items.text: The storage pocket lets you stow away all the nick-nacks that you bring on your adventures.

sections.title: LIFESTYLE FLEXIBILITY
sections.intro: The Axopar 22 combines trailering convenience with sociable forward seating and an optional waterski frame for active days on the water.

sections.title: Alternatives for Aft Deck
sections.intro: The modular nature of Axopars and our multi-platform thinking enable you to customize your boat with an aft layout to suit your everyday needs. As standard, the Axopar 22 Spyder comes with an Aft Sofa. The aft deck can also be equipped with an optional Multi Storage Compartment or a U-Sofa, with the option to extend it into a sun bed.

sections.title: Upgrade Options
sections.intro: Elevate your Axopar 22 with the stylish BRABUS Line for a refined, premium look and feel — or choose the BRABUS Performance Line for extra power and exhilarating speed. For those who value ultimate comfort, the Mediterrana Edition and Soft Decking create a luxurious onboard experience, perfect for lounging and entertaining.

items.title: BRABUS Line
modal_text:
Elevate your Axopar 22 with the stylish BRABUS Line for a refined, premium look and feel

The BRABUS Line option includes:

BRABUS steering wheel

BRABUS map pocket

BRABUS badges

Black cleats

Axopar hull logo in black

Black ventilation grills

Black handrails

If the Audio System is selected, the speaker grills are dark.

Optional exterior rigging, such as engine frame and pulpits, is offered in black.

items.title: BRABUS Line Color Edition
modal_text: For style-conscious customers looking to make their Axopar 22 truly stand out, the Brabus Line Color Edition introduces four striking hull colors: the vibrant, playful Miami Blue; the more subtle, sophisticated Platinum Grey. The fresh, contemporary Glacier Blue; and the timeless, elegant Pearl White. These duo-tone color options combine colored areas with uncolored sections in a standard white finish, giving the boat a dynamic and distinctive look.

items.title: BRABUS Performance Line
modal_text: The BRABUS Performance Line features stylish hull graphics and an extra boost of power on the transom, courtesy of a Mercury Verado 250hp engine, to get you to your adventure destination promptly.

items.title: The Mediterrana Edition
modal_text:
The upholstery features exclusive, subtle yet stylish detailing, accentuated patterns, and a structured feel of marine fabrics. The fabric keeps the interior and lounging areas at comfortable temperatures, even on the warmest summer days.

The Mediterrana Edition features and options:

Outdoor waterproof fabric

Extended fore deck seating with cupholders and bolsters

Mediterrana Soft Decking

Extended sun bed cushions on the Multi Storage Compartment

Extended sun bed cushions for u-sofa

Harbor covers

items.title: Axopar X Jobe Edition
modal_text:
Here at Axopar, we felt the need to offer an even deeper, more immersive water sports experience aboard our new Axopar 22 Spyder.

This was how two of the world’s leading manufacturers found each other: the iconic Jobe Sports from the Netherlands and Axopar Boats from Finland. Together, we are now the first partnership to produce a boat range specifically tailored to its matching water-sports products. Our shared passion for fun on the water, innovation, knowhow and years of experience would together allow us to create one of the best water sports concepts in the leisure marine industry.

sections.title: Configurations & Layouts
sections.intro: We want to provide you with an extensively customizable, user-friendly boat that meets your everyday needs year-round and supports all your adventures. The configuration you choose will define the final layout of your boat. Below are a few examples of available layouts.

items.caption: In just a few short moments, you'll feel relaxed, at ease, and fully in control behind the wheel of an Axopar. Responsive handling and safe manners make driving this as simple and intuitive as driving a modern-day car.
Simply drop the optional additional sun bed cushions into place to create a wide sun pad that serves as a spacious, comfortable area to bask in the warm sun with a cold beverage.

Both the driver and co-driver seats can be turned to face the sofa to entertain guests at the optional table. This is a perfect place to socialize and enjoy a lunch or a cup of coffee with your friends.
By implementing a classic Axopar hull in a smaller size, the outcome is a boat that is easy to manoeuvre in tight spaces with minimum windage impact.

The angle of the windscreen is adjustable, providing full protection while you are seated and allowing you to raise the top of the windscreen higher for protection while driving in a standing position.
